Subject: Pre-board briefing: Q3 highlights + OKR signoffs

Team — attaching my first-pass deck for next Tuesday's board briefing (Q3 highlights + ask list). Please focus on two things this week: 1) any factual corrections in slides 2–8 (metrics and product milestones), and 2) one-line approval / objection for the OKR snapshot on slide 11.

High level: revenue beat plan (net new ARR up 18%), gross margin flat vs Q2, a couple of customer escalations closed (see appendix). We still have an open ask for 6 months runway extension we may surface depending on board tone.

Deliverable timeline: please add comments in the Drive file linked below by EOD Thu (10/8). If you have substantive edits that change narrative, flag in thread and we'll triage.

Attachments: Q3_board_brief_v1.pptx, okrs_snapshot_q3.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q3-board-briefing-draft

Thanks — Grace

Subject: Re: Pre-board briefing: Q3 highlights + OKR signoffs

Grace — quick pass from finance. Overall looks tight but reasonable. Two quick items:

- Slide 4 (NRR chart): the legend uses % but numbers are decimals; updated figures should be 102.1% not 1.021. I'll drop a corrected csv in the Drive.
- Slide 7 (runway scenarios): please add a conservative scenario that assumes a 10% slowdown in bookings for Q4; board will want to see downside plan.

I put line comments in the Drive and attached the corrected data file (data_appendix_q3.csv). If we push the runway ask, we should route the updated financial model to Legal and People so we can speak to hiring impacts.

—Michael

Adding product notes — thanks Grace. A few edits to the product roadmap slides:

- Slide 10: move the LLM latency reduction milestone (from Nov->Oct) to reflect earlier rollout of the optimized runtime; call out quantization experiments as 'in production canary'.
- Slide 12 (customer stories): add a one-line blurb for Apostrophe Health (they agreed to a 6-month pilot); I attached the PRD link in the Drive comments.

Also, OKR snapshot: I'm comfortable signing off if we rephrase Objective 2 to be less binary (replace 'achieve' with 'target'). That avoids the optics of a missed key result. One-line from me: "OKR snapshot approved with wording tweak on Obj2."

—Mina

- Michael: received corrected NRR and data appendix; will include the conservative runway scenario on slide 7.
- Mina: will update product milestone language and add Apostrophe Health one-liner.
- Marcus: adding an 'asks' slide up front; tightening hiring language.
- Stephanie: can you run a final copy edit and ensure footnotes link to the Drive appendix?

Please add any final comments to the Drive doc by EOD Mon (10/12) so we can lock materials and share the board packet.
